business_problem: Fulton County Schools, which serves just under 90,000 students in the Atlanta, Georgia, metropolitan area, transformed its data-driven decision-making with dynamic analytic insights using Microsoft Power BI.

Fulton County Schools, which serves just under 90,000 students in the Atlanta, Georgia, metropolitan area, transformed its data-driven decision-making with dynamic analytic insights using Microsoft Power BI. In today's data-driven world, school districts are eager to harness advanced data analytics to personalize student learning, improve instruction, and boost operational efficiency. In 2022, the school district deployed internal dashboards built in Power BI to help instructors, administrators, and the board of education easily see near-real-time information about student performance. The implementation centers on Power BI to support real-time analytics workflows.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and analytics views for operational and executive users.
